scope_zh: 已参与开发的九条公开PoolFire轨迹，干净有限背景归一化BOS代理，原生7/9个已知嵌套相机；探索性完整留轨迹LOTO，不是未开外部或真实BOST。
scope_en: Nine development-visible public PoolFire trajectories, clean normalized finite-background BOS proxy, native7/9 known nested cameras. Exploratory complete-trajectory LOTO, not unopened external or real BOST.
primary: Unchanged five-camera-trained outer-fold weights, mean/scale/seven RMS, Euclidean observation norm; native active-camera encoder and the same exact ridge lift. No count rescaling or fallback.
controls: Frozen Linear0 uses the same five-camera fold statistics. NativeCachedMean0 and NativeGMM0 use only808 legal source frames per native count/fold.18 fixed strong-GMM fits; no neural refit. Mean/Range/GMM all match909 queries and9 tails at each count. Keep inherited pure classical controls.
matching_gate: Every primary frame <=1.01 times the same independently adequate Reference128 error +1e-10 for all4 metrics.
independent_scope: Separate encoder/head/solver/physical replay and metrics; shared canonical prediction operator/factor, frozen neural weights and one statistical EM fit per fold. Not an independent optimizer.
population_seal: Both counts, all9 folds, all5 new actions and both numerical paths globally sealed before held quality scoring. Own-fold source truth used only for808-frame statistical-control fitting.
resource_scope: Geometry cache and offline source/control fitting are nonfree. This run is not a fresh wall/RSS benchmark. Five-camera resource results do not establish seven/nine-camera timing.
